title: Poh Ling Yeow Defends Meghan Markle Against 'Horrible' Backlash for New Gig: 'Will of Steel'
text: Poh Ling Yeow Defends Meghan Markle Against 'Horrible' Backlash for New Gig: 'Will of Steel' Poh Ling Yeow, the co-host of the upcoming Junior MasterChef Australia reboot, has defended Meghan Markle against the backlash she received after the announcement of her new role. Yeow described Meghan as having a 'will of steel' and expressed admiration for her resilience in the face of criticism. The pair will be teaming up to host the show, which is set to air in 2027, marking a return to the small screen for the beloved cooking competition. The Duchess of Sussex's new gig drew mixed reactions after it was announced but Yeow, 52, defended Meghan against the backlash while speaking \"Honestly, that was a really crazy experience to actually watch the fallout,\" Yeow admitted. \"Seriously, the woman has a will of steel and I just have even more admiration for her. \"Meghan Markle will make her return to television as cohost of Junior MasterChef Australia. Australia's Network 10 announced the news on Tuesday, October 27, revealing that Meghan, 45, will team up with professional cook Poh Ling Yeow to host the upcoming reboot, which will air in 2027.Meghan's appointment as cohost comes after she made \"I think rumors just follow because it's just the nature of the beast, you know. Like people are insatiable and horrible and you know,\" Yeow continued. The Australian TV host added that she also copped some heat by association, explaining, \"I guess I was latently experiencing it because some of it even came my way but it's like, it's fine.Junior MasterChef Australia Return\"Meghan will film the spinoff series over two weeks in May 2027, with the season slated to air later the same year. , so when they approached me to come back and work with this young group of talent, it was an easy yes,\" Meghan said in a statement on Tuesday, October 27.
